name: TR Dogal Enerji Kaynaklari Arastirma ve Uretim Anonim Sirketi
summary: TR Dogal Enerji Kaynaklari Arastirma ve Üretim AS engages in the exploration and development of natural resources. Its activities include discovery, drilling, and generation of petroleum, natural gas, coal, and other natural energy resources. The company was founded by Melek Ipek, Hamdi Akin Ipek, Cafer Tekin Ipek, and Pelin Ipek on January 15, 1968 and is headquartered in Ankara, Turkey.
